batches.definition: The reply states or cites a policy rule whose document the conversation never opened with get_policy; a search snippet does not count as opened.
A case SPEC always sends to a human (ESC-1 to ESC-3, e.g. a dispute) ends without an escalate_to_human call.
The agent answers a request SCOPE-2 requires it to refuse, instead of declining.
The user describes an order by product and the agent answers without calling find_order although its role may.

batches.rule: guidance: \busually\b|look for|point you to|send this|^\s*\d+\.\s | offer: \bif you (tell|share|send|let) me\b|\bI can (help you|point|walk|draft|look)\b
